Class RangeObstacleDetector

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics.navigation.RangeObstacleDetector
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObstacleDetector
public final class RangeObstacleDetector extends Object implements ObstacleDetector
An ObstacleDetector over a forward-facing RangeFinder, such as a Grove Ultrasonic Ranger: blocked once confirmReadings readings in a row are nearer than stopMillimetres, and clear again only once a reading is beyond clearMillimetres or finds no echo. The confirmation ignores a single stray echo, and the gap between the two distances keeps a reading near the limit from switching it on and off. A range finder's NaN, no echo, counts as a clear way.

leJOS's RangeFeatureDetector notifies its listeners on every reading while something is in range; this one only answers when asked, so a pilot reads it at its own pace. Create it once at startup.
